title: The Gate
objective: Get a username past the reserved-name filter that still resolves to the protected identity.

reserved_filter.label: Reserved-name filter
reserved_filter.detail: Rejects a username that exactly matches the reserved name.

identity_resolution.label: Identity resolution
identity_resolution.detail: Normalizes the username to NFC before looking up the reserved name.

hints: Inspect the accented character in the Workbench. Compare its NFC and NFD code points.

feedback.failed: Access denied. The gateway requires both checks to pass.

recovered: Registry note · Two registration IDs map to the same canonical identity. The record of who approved the merge is missing.
